# GitHub Copilot instructions

This repository is `windows-optimize`, a Go Packer provisioner with embedded Windows PowerShell 5.1 guest scripts. Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [INVARIANTS.md](../INVARIANTS.md) before changing anything. AGENTS.md lists the module map, coding rules and the checks to run before committing.

Report which checks you actually ran. Mocked tests don't verify a real WinRM build.
